TextLanguage.description: Select the language of the fix settings; Automatic follows the game.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate in addition to the game’s own option. Higher rates have not been fully tested.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while it is active.
plugin.name: Resident Evil 5 Fusion Fix
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the field of view of the gameplay camera, which already widens with the screen (Hor+). Aiming and cutscenes keep theirs.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logos and the logo movie at start-up, confirm the start-up notices that only have an OK button ("Load successful", the auto-save notice). Story movies stay.
SkipPressStart.description: Go past the PRESS ANY KEY screen at start-up.
WindowMode.description: The window when the game's own fullscreen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show both players' health on supported Logitech keyboards. Requires Logitech G HUB.
ColorFilter.description: The yellow-orange colour grade of the levels. Off shows the scenes in neutral colours; the game's own Special Settings filters still work.
ModernControls.description: Controls like Resident Evil 6: a free over-the-shoulder camera, movement relative to the camera, walking while aiming, using the knife, reloading and switching weapons, one-button reload, quick turn and dodges. Pad and keyboard/mouse.
KnifeParry.description: Swing or raise the knife just before an enemy's melee attack or grab lands to block it: the enemy staggers and can be hit with a melee attack. A grab that already holds you can't be parried.
ForceLaserSight.description: Aim with the weapon's laser sight on keyboard/mouse too, exactly as with a pad: the laser shows and the crosshair is hidden.
WFP_PLUGINS_HELP: Settings of the Fusion Fix and the other plugins.
WFP_PRESET_HELP: Vanilla: the original look with fixes. Recommended: a balanced setup. Enhanced: additional visual changes.
WFP_RESTOREDEFAULTS_HELP: Sets this page's settings to their defaults.
WFP_RESTART_WARNING: Restart the game to apply the changed settings.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen, at its sides. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 16:9 layout. Applies immediately.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the original cinematic bars; Pillarbox keeps cutscenes at 16:9 with bars at the sides on wider screens. Without the letterbox the picture fills the height and keeps its framing. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Open the pause menu when another window becomes active (windowed and borderless). Turn off to keep the game running in the background; it still ignores keys, mouse and pad meant for other windows. Applies immediately.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
MovingTurnSpeed.description: How fast the character turns while walking and running, with the mouse or a stick. The game turns slower while moving than standing; 1.0x keeps the game's speed. With Modern controls the camera turns freely and this doesn't apply.
ShadowResolution.description: Size of the shadow maps with the game's High shadow quality. Game keeps 1024; higher values give sharper shadows. Needs a restart.
GamepadIcons.description: The button symbols shown for a controller in prompts and action buttons. Auto and Xbox keep the game's symbols.
SplitScreenLayout.description: How local co-op divides the screen. Game keeps the game's own split mode option (both players one above the other). Side by Side gives each player the left or right half; on a 32:9 screen that is a 16:9 view per player. Each player's HUD fits into their half. Applies immediately.
